name: dev-flow
description: Drives features and fixes through four phases: define, build, verify, and deliver. The workflow includes a required documentation-consistency checkpoint before pull request delivery, resumes from gitignored state, and keeps each gate in order. Includes brainstorm, plan, TDD, execution, test, review, documentation, PR, issue, and close-out skills plus the /new-feature, /new-idea, and /bootstrap commands. Fully self-contained — no external plugin dependencies.
